rules.naming: Events are lowercase snake_case `ai_agent__<object>_<action>` (plus `pageview`, copied from dayuse.com); properties are snake_case.
rules.evolution: Append only: never rename or remove an event, a property or an enum value.
rules.sentinels: A string property with no value is sent as "unknown" (or "none" where listed in its enum), never null. A property marked optional is omitted when it has no value.
rules.emitter: Every event is sent by the widget. Properties with "source": "turn_facts" are copied from the `turn_facts` block of the /v3 response.

session_replay.description: Share of Amplitude sessions recorded by Session Replay, served by the widget proxy's /sr-config so Amplitude's remote settings cannot change it; synthetic runs are never recorded.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's session id, equal to the Langfuse session_id.

tracking_surface.description: Where the widget runs: a browser, or the app's WebView.

app_platform.description: The app's OS on mobile_app, "none" on web.

entry_source.description: How the user reached the agent: the dayuse.com entry point, the app, another deep link, or none.

domain.description: Hostname serving the widget, e.g. ai.dayuse.com.

market_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the market, "unknown" before one is known.

language.description: Language the agent answers in, e.g. "fr".

agent_version.description: Deployed commit SHA, equal to LANGFUSE_RELEASE; "unknown" locally.

is_synthetic.description: True for scripted runs (`?du_synthetic=1`); exclude these from every KPI.

dayuse_event_id.description: A UUID per event, as on dayuse.com.

pageview.description: The widget page loads; fires once per load.

url_and_query_string.description: Path plus query string of the page URL.

referrer_domain.description: Hostname of the referrer, "none" when empty.

page_type.description: Always "ai_agent"; tells the agent's pageviews apart from dayuse.com's.

ai_agent__message_sent.description: User sends a message to the agent, typed or from a button.

turn_id.description: Client-minted turn id, echoed back by the server.

prompt.description: The message text, truncated to 500 characters.

prompt_source.description: What produced the message: typing, the deep link's `q`, or a suggestion chip.

message_length.description: Character count of the full, untruncated message.

ai_agent__response_received.description: The agent's answer to a message is complete (`done` frame or JSON response).

langfuse_trace_id.description: Langfuse trace of this turn, "none" when tracing is off.

response_type.description: Hotels shown, a question back to the user, or a text answer.

hotel_ids.description: Ids of the hotels shown, in display order.

empty_reason.description: Why a search showed no hotel; "none" when hotels were shown or no search ran.

clarification_reason.description: What the agent asked back; "none" unless response_type is clarification.

route.description: Component that answered, e.g. leaf:hotel_search, template:ack, inline:generate_booking_link.

status.description: Turn outcome as the spine reports it; "unknown" when the response carries no turn_facts.

guards_fired.description: GUARD_SCORE_NAMES entries that fired this turn, sorted.

fallbacks.description: FALLBACK_SCORE_NAMES entries taken this turn, sorted.

resolved_city.description: City the search was anchored on after geocoding, "unknown" when none.

has_booking_card.description: A booking card was shown this turn.

search_country.description: ISO country of the search, "unknown" when none.

ttft_ms.description: Send to first `progress` frame; streaming transport only.

ai_agent__response_failed.description: A message got no answer: HTTP error, network error, or a widget error while handling the response.

langfuse_trace_id.description: Present when a `progress` frame arrived before the failure.

error_type.description: Kind of failure; "client" is an exception in the widget after the server answered.

http_status.description: Status code when error_type is http.

ai_agent__hotel_click.description: User clicks toward a hotel from the agent's answer.

turn_id.description: Turn whose answer showed the card.

langfuse_trace_id.description: Trace of that turn, "none" when unknown.

position.description: 1-based position of the card in its list.

clicked_element.description: Element clicked: a hotel card's call to action.

ai_agent__booking_card_click.description: User clicks the booking card's link to the dayuse.com checkout.

turn_id.description: Turn whose answer showed the booking card.

langfuse_trace_id.description: Trace of that turn, "none" when unknown.

rate_plan_id.description: Offer or rate plan selected, "unknown" when the card has none.

ai_agent__suggestion_click.description: User clicks a suggestion chip in the chat; the message it sends is tracked separately.

turn_id.description: Turn whose answer showed the chip; absent for chips shown before any turn.

suggestion_type.description: Kind of chip, e.g. search_example, welcome, recovery, or near_me (the « near me » chip, web hero and app welcome, since 2026-10-28).

position.description: 1-based position of the chip in its row.

ai_agent__feedback_submit.description: User rates an answer with thumbs up or down.

langfuse_trace_id.description: Trace of that turn; the same rating is stored as a Langfuse score on it.
